message: job lock in .github/workflows/ci.yml (line 6) runs PDM with --exclude-newer 1h, which sets the release-age delay of PDM to 1 hour, shorter than the 3d of depcurfew.json
fix: Remove --exclude-newer 1h from that command in .github/workflows/ci.yml; for a package that cannot wait, add it to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply

message: POETRY_SOLVER_MIN_RELEASE_AGE=0 is set for poetry in a run step of job lock in .github/workflows/ci.yml, reaches the Poetry commands it runs, and turns off the release-age delay of Poetry (3d in depcurfew.json)
fix: Remove POETRY_SOLVER_MIN_RELEASE_AGE from that command in .github/workflows/ci.yml; for a package that cannot wait, add it to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply
